A long or short call counts as right only if price moved more than 0.25% its way (about one round trip of fees). A flat call is right if price stayed within ±0.25%. Price is measured from the first Binance minute after the block ends, so nothing the vote could not see is used. Calls after 12:00 are not graded to the close.
